reason: Compare fresh on-policy plane experience with legacy-only continuation after Soft4 failed. Keep inference architecture, deployment search, board mass and optimizer-step count identical.

data.branch: Restore floor(N/3) legal prefix moves from an original teacher game in the same partition. Select sorted eligible origin by FNV1a(dataSeed|board|index|origin). Origin must have >=prefix+8 moves. Record full history and group every fork with original origin for splitting. Record new training rows only after the restored prefix.
data.capPolicy: Save all trajectories. Any capped game fails this data recipe; no relabeling or replacement.
data.exploration: Sample played teacher/baseline policy with temperature1 until min(18,N/3), temperature0.25 until N/2, then argmax. In the first phase use25% Dirichlet noise with concentration10 for played-action sampling only. Teacher labels remain noise-free.
data.exclusion: All pilot/screen/independent/reported-L6 games are excluded. Original validation families remain validation, including forks.

training.curveReplay: 100% unchanged legacy data; every board retains1/9 total training mass. Within each plane board NewData has70% legacy+30% fresh; Control has100% legacy.
training.commonValidation: Both inputs contain identical original and fresh validation roots. Validation has the same within-board70/30 mixture on planes, legacy-only curves. Control input excludes fresh training games entirely. Pin all game IDs and assert origin-family split integrity and equal selection-corpus hashes.
training.selection: Lowest common validation loss including epoch0, no auxiliary head, no policy anchor or surprise replay.
training.rationale: The16-epoch1e-4 schedule follows the earlier successful distillation recipe; both arms have identical updates. This round changes data availability, not the recipe between arms.

preflight.control: Integrity/export checks required; no improvement gate. Epoch0 remains valid.
tests: Full replay and root feature/legal/area labels for every fresh game
Fixed board mass/old-new mixture and identical update counts
Identical common selection corpus across arms
Original inference format and actual CPU/WebGPU Worker checks

development.selection: NewData only: all gates plus higher total score than Control. No candidate/epoch substitution after development.

matches.seedFormula: FNV1a32(phaseSeed|board|pair|ply); shared legal4-move opening and per-turn seed in swapped colours and both arms
matches.cappedGames: Retain, score actual Game area, report count; no outcome-dependent replacement

latency.secondary: If strength passes, freeze equal-time development protocol from baseline-only calibration before candidate timing; report separately.

stopping: If data, preflight or development fails, archive and stop this round. One independent candidate only; no extra games, retries, replacement models or parameter tuning after independent failure. No hosted deployment.
limitations: One training seed is a resource-limited causal comparison; independent matches test the selected model against deployed baseline, not method superiority in general.
